title: Zarr rendering test catalog
description: Local Portolan catalog for the Zarr map rendering work. Each collection points at a public Zarr or Icechunk store and covers one outcome the browser has to produce: a store that draws, a store held back to a zoom level, a store refused for its chunk shape, and a store refused for its codec. Run `node tests/fixtures/catalogs/zarr/build.mjs` to rebuild the derived collections. Serve this catalog with node tests/fixtures/serve-catalogs.mjs, which puts it on port 8082. See docs/zarr.md.
